text:
sara: heads-up — saw a CUDA OOM on gpu-03 during the canary rollout of two models (llama2-13b-q4 + gptj-6b) at ~11:12 UTC. No user-facing errors yet but latency tails spiked.

jonathan: can you paste the error/logs? was it allocation failure or reserve failure?

sara: paste here —
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 536870912 bytes (GPU 0; 24.00 GiB total capacity; 21.37 GiB already allocated; 402.50 MiB free; 2.00 GiB reserved in other contexts)
  File "/opt/redwood/runtime/alloc.cpp", line 412, in allocate
```

infra-bot: auto-mem-snapshot for gpu-03 at 2026-04-01T11:12:08Z:
```
MODEL	TYPE	RESERVED_MB	ALLOCATED_MB	KV_CACHE_MB	FRAG_PCT
llama2-13b-q4	decoder	7680	6300	2048	18
gptj-6b	decoder	6144	5120	512	12
other.system	1024	800	0	9
TOTAL_RESERVED: 15848 MB  TOTAL_ALLOCATED: 12220 MB  GPU_TOTAL: 24576 MB
```

priya: looks like KV cache + fragmentation killed the usable free region. small allocations for logits + attention workspace were failing because free contiguous chunk < 512MB. profiler shows lots of ~32KB allocations leading to fragmentation.

hana: is this the new batching heuristic change we merged yesterday? we changed to aggressive packing for high-util queues. might have co-located two large models.

leo: yep, scheduler packed both because both were under the pack_risk threshold. we also disabled the soft reserve feature to max throughput.

max: so two problems: (1) fragmentation from many small allocations (workspace + KV slices) and (2) no per-model soft reserve to protect peak allocations. both lead to OOM when a request has a large workspace need.

jonathan: proposed quick mitigations —
- re-enable per-model soft_reserve (default 2GB for >10B-equivalent)
- enable KV-slice LRU eviction (evict inactive key-slices older than 10s)
- switch allocator mode to hybrid-fit which uses size-segregated bins + occasional Coalesce pass
- temporarily revert aggressive packing for canaries (pack_risk -> conservative)

priya: adding profiling snippets —heavy tail in alloc counts:
```
alloc-size histogram (last 5m):
<=4KB: 842k
4-64KB: 1.1M
64-512KB: 48k
>512KB: 370
largest contiguous free blocks: 256MB, 128MB, 96MB
fragmentation_est: 16.9%
```

sara: can we implement KV-slice eviction without impacting logits? eviction must only target cold KV pages (past 10s idle). we saw repeated rehotting on the 2nd request in some chat flows.

hana: implement LRU per KV-slice with a read/write flag: reads bump hot window; async rehydrate from host if evicted. should be transparent to user unless rehydrate latency > 30ms -> then fallback to smaller model variant.

leo: note: host swap (pinned host pagecache) would reduce OOM but increases latency tail. worth the trade for non-latency-critical tenants. we need per-tenant policy.

max: latency telemetry from canary shows 95p spikes to 1.2s when swapping from host; baseline 95p ~120ms. hopefully acceptable for internal canaries but not for SLA customers.

jonathan: config sketch to roll out as canary patch:
```
{"allocator":"hybrid-fit","soft_reserve_mb":2048,"kv_eviction_policy":"lru-slice","kv_evict_idle_s":10,"swap_strategy":"async-host-pagecache","pack_risk":"conservative"}
```
(canary only on gpu-03)

sara: +1 for canary. assign owners? I'll handle soft_reserve + scheduler change. Priya can adapt KV eviction and telemetry hooks. Jonathan will wire allocator mode and the coalesce pass. Hana will add fallback path to smaller model and redirect logic. Leo will write host-swap policy doc. Max — keep an eye on SLO alert thresholds.

deploy-bot: deploy started for patch 2026-04-01T11:45:12Z -> canary(gpu-03). CI ran smoke tests.

infra-bot: canary snapshot after deploy (11:52 UTC):
```
MODEL	RESERVED	ALLOCATED	KV_CACHE
llama2-13b-q4	9728	7100	1536
gptj-6b	6144	4700	256
FRAG_PCT: 9.4%  TOTAL_FREE_CONTIG: 768MB
```

priya: initial numbers look promising — fragmentation dropped, free contiguous grew to 768MB. KV eviction cut cold-slice memory by ~30%.

max: latency tails back to normal for now. watch for rehot patterns — if the same conversation reuses KV right after eviction, we may see a 50-80ms rehydrate penalty.

jonathan: long-term items listed in thread:
- implement per-model workspace sizing heuristics based on p95 sequence length and batch mix
- smarter kernel selection that prefers kernels with lower transient workspace when fragmentation high
- proactive periodic coalesce/defrag in low-util windows
- model packing risk scoring (size, kv-pressure, quantization memory profile)
- async host-swap for inactive model shards with tenant-level opt-in

sara: filing a short postmortem and ops runbook for co-residency OOMs. will include emergency steps to flip pack_risk and disable co-location via placement tags.

hana: also adding a small unit test harness for KV-slice LRU to catch rehotting regressions.

leo: I'll draft the host-swap policy and perf budget for rehydration.

sara: thanks all — good catch. follow-up meeting tomorrow 10:00 to scope implementation and perf regressions tracking. :thumbsup:
